name: Sublime-TM1
summary: A Sublime Text add-in for TM1 developers: edit rules and TurboIntegrator processes against a live server, with auto-complete, syntax checking, auto-formatting and a thread viewer.
description: A TurboIntegrator process and rules editor for IBM Planning Analytics (TM1), built on Sublime Text: get and update rules and processes on a live server through the REST API, with auto-complete for every function, syntax checking from the server, auto-formatting, and a viewer for the server's threads.
